title: Phase 1: Project Scaffolding & Infrastructure
description: Create the full project skeleton with modern Python packaging and CI, modeled after the zorg project. ~15 new files including pyproject.toml, setup.cfg, tox.ini, Makefile, targets.mk, .github/workflows/ci.yml, .gitignore, README.md, CLAUDE.md, requirements.in, requirements-dev.in, .pylintrc, src/sase/__init__.py, and src/sase/py.typed. Key decisions: setuptools backend, setuptools_scm versioning, Python >=3.12, entry point sase=sase.main.entry:main. Verify with pip install -e . before committing.
close_reason: All 13 scaffolding files created and verified: .gitignore, pyproject.toml, src/sase/__init__.py, py.typed, __main__.py, main/__init__.py, main/entry.py, tox.ini, Justfile, README.md, CLAUDE.md, ci.yml, CONTRIBUTING.md. All verification checks pass: CLI works, imports work, ruff passes, mypy passes, pytest runs clean, build produces wheel+sdist.

title: Phase 2: Migrate & Rename Source Code
description: Copy all 334 Python source files from ~/lib/gai/src/ into src/sase/, restructure imports for proper packaging, and rename all gai references to sase. Prefix all intra-package imports with sase. (e.g., from ace.foo import bar -> from sase.ace.foo import bar). Rename files (gai_utils.py -> sase_utils.py), functions (get_gai_directory -> get_sase_directory), config paths (~/.config/gai -> ~/.config/sase), env vars (GAI_* -> SASE_*), CLI prog name, and docstrings. Manual review needed for false positives (words containing gai like again).

title: Phase 5: Verification & Final Polish
description: Ensure no remaining gai references, all tests pass, linters clean, packaging works. Run rg '\bgai\b' (must return empty), pip install -e ., sase --help, make test, make lint. Also scan for gai_ prefixes, .gai config paths, and GAI env vars. Fix all issues, final commit and push.

title: Phase 4: Migrate Supporting Files
description: Copy docs (7 files), xprompts (18 files), and schema files. Rename all gai references to sase. Migrate gai.schema.json -> config/sase.schema.json. Update CLAUDE.md schema path references.

title: Phase 3: Migrate & Rename Tests
description: Copy all 197 test files from ~/lib/gai/test/ into tests/, update imports and rename references. Rename test_gai_utils.py -> test_sase_utils.py. Update all gai references in test strings, assertions, and mock paths. Update conftest.py for new package structure. Run pytest tests/ to verify all tests pass.
